title: New Delhi
desc: An honest journalist is illegally detained in a mental asylum when he tries to expose two corrupt politicians. After his release, he plans to exact revenge on the people who wronged him.

title: Zakhm
desc: The story revolves around a young boy, Ajay, who grows up torn between his mother's Muslim identity and his father's Hindu beliefs. When his mother is killed in a communal riot, Ajay is forced to confront his past and reconcile his conflicted identity. The film explores themes of love, loss, and communal harmony against the backdrop of religious tensions in India.

title: Izzat
desc: Constable Ram Chandra teaches his son Siddharth to be a diligent policeman and lead his life with honesty and dignity. Siddharth follows his advice until circumstances force him to leave his ideals.

title: Aa Gale Lag Jaa
desc: Roshni, a rich girl, is adamant on marrying Suraj, who is poor, until her mother reveals that his father is a former convict. Later, people around them are brutally killed by a seemingly unstoppable assailant.

title: Dastaan
desc: Vishnu, a reputed judge, is assumed to be Anil, an absconding murderer. However, he decides to travel to Anil's home town and unravel the mystery behind his lookalike's existence.
